verification: Configuration and browser rendering tested. Actual app launch, accepted home routes, and every reissued iOS version require physical-device testing. Do not describe the catalog as device-verified.

banks.notes: Official documents confirm sberbankonline, sbolonline and onlineios-app schemes in SSO/payment examples. Only their bare roots are used here, with no SSO/payment parameters. Bare-root handling and opening the home screen are NOT confirmed.
tinkoffbank://Main is a candidate native home route. An official launch specification was not obtained; no physical-device verification. Do not treat configuration tests as proof of bank support.

User confirmed the installed app is А-Ключ. kluch:// is a candidate launch URI for that release; alfabank:// is offered separately for legacy installs. No official launch specification or physical-device verification was obtained.

User confirmed the otp custom scheme opens the installed iPhone app but the bare base displays an error. User also confirmed the /mobile-bank Universal Link opens the website. Replace both with otp://ru.otpbank.mobile/toMain. The /toMain alias is paired with MainDeeplinkProcessor in the official RuStore Android APK 2.19.1-gms (202610071), classes5.dex, Lhi7;.<clinit>, code item 0x1cf158. The native base otp://ru.otpbank.mobile/ is also an APK constant. This is bank-published Android route evidence, not proof of iOS route compatibility. The exact iOS route and successful launch still require device testing. No app installed or executed; no website fallback, tracking redirects, payment/auth parameters, timers or automatic probing.

User reports sirius:// opens Sirius but hangs. Info.plist confirms the scheme only. Further static inspection of the same Sirius 2.0.1 (110), com.sm.FlowTime, found the complete embedded URL sirius://siriusapp.com/i/welcomes in Payload/Sirius.app/Sirius, file offset 0xda2530, adjacent to DeeplinkDecoder constants. Use that full URL; do not invent a /Main or online.vtb.ru path. Evidence records binary SHA-256, URL offset and constants. Archive is hosted by a third party; bank/Apple signature and actual iPhone launch are not verified. No app was installed or executed.

The Apple-cached bank-ozon.onelink.me AASA maps /JbZg/* exclusively to 29PJ6W9657.ru.ozon.fintech.finance. Marketplace clients own /kh30/* instead. Use https://bank-ozon.onelink.me/JbZg/ directly from the user-tapped anchor. Trailing slash is required by the published wildcard pattern. This is an iOS Universal Link, not a generic bank homepage. HTTP-only iPhone-UA check returns the bank App Store ID 1629869891, not marketplace ID 407804998. Actual installed-app launch was not tested. Without the matching installed app, or when iOS Universal Links are disabled, the handler may open the App Store; no custom scheme is invented from the bank name. Android APK from the official CDN also declares ozonbank but that alone is not considered proof of iOS scheme support.

The official Halva installation guide recommends the personal web bank for iPhone users and links to /lk, which redirects to /lk2. Use the published /lk entry point as an explicit webApp target, not as an automatic fallback after a native launch. Open it in a separate tab without referrer or offer data. No native URI, timers, authentication/payment parameters or arbitrary user-provided URL. Android keeps its existing native Intent. A real click from the local application in the desktop in-app browser opened /lk2/ in a separate tab and displayed the bank phone-login form. No credentials were entered. This was a browser check at mobile viewport size, not Safari on a physical iPhone. The exact installed iOS Home Screen web-app launch and authenticated bank flows were not verified.
